findings.summary: Park Hyatt St Kitts CBI project timeline confirmed: Agreement signed July 10, 2012 at Park Hyatt Dubai between Range Developments, Hyatt affiliate, and Kiawah Partners. PM Denzil Douglas and Tourism Minister Ricky Skerritt attended press conference. St. Kitts government approved concept/design plans April 2013. Groundbreaking June 3, 2013 with PM Douglas presiding. Project funded via St Kitts CBI programme at USD 400,000/share. Opened November 1, 2017 with 126 rooms.

Range Developments Group full corporate structure: 7+ identified subsidiaries across 4 jurisdictions (UAE, Dominica, Grenada, T&T). Parent HQ Boulevard Plaza Tower 2 Dubai. Subsidiaries: Range Capital Partners (Dominica) Ltd, Range Capital Markets (Dominica) Ltd, Range International Consultants, Range Development Grenada Ltd, Range RAK (UAE), Range Luxury (Dubai). Group claims 15000+ individuals assisted with citizenship, 5500+ jobs created, 1600+ investor families.

findings.summary: Range Developments full CBI project portfolio: (1) Park Hyatt St Kitts (opened 2017, 126 rooms, CBI at USD 400-430K/share, project value 200M+), (2) InterContinental Dominica Cabrits (opened Oct 2019, 151 rooms, USD 195M from 800 family passports at 220K each), (3) Six Senses La Sagesse Grenada (56 pool suites + 15 villas), (4) InterContinental Grenada La Sagesse (150 rooms, opening 2026), (5) La Sagesse Collection (60/96 residences), (6) Port Cabrits Marina Dominica (150 berths, USD 75M via CBI). Total: 15000+ individuals granted citizenship, 1600+ investor families across all projects.

Range response: applicants only invested once qualified by government due diligence. UK imposed visa requirements on Dominican citizens 2023 citing clear and evident abuse. Dominica CBI generated approx USD 5M/month per PM Skerrit.

findings.summary: Range Developments ICC arbitration outcome: Zampolli counterclaims dismissed by tribunal. Range obtained English High Court anti-suit injunction (Justice Butcher, 28 Feb 2019 interim; Justice Waksman, 15 Mar 2019 final order, costs GBP 61,896.50 awarded against Zampolli). Separately, Newton and Mack found liable for tortious interference and defamation against Asaria/Range in DeKalb County Court Georgia -- damages in millions. Also Hayes v Hyatt (NCWB, 2025, Docket 25-03091) adversary proceeding in bankruptcy naming Range Developments Ltd and Christophe Harbour.

Grenada Land Actors Inc v PDA/Range Development Grenada Ltd: Environmental lawsuit challenging La Sagesse resort EIA. Eastern Caribbean Supreme Court of Appeal ruled Oct 2024 that case can proceed. Allegations: salt pond at La Sagesse backfilled in breach of Integrated Coastal Zone Management Act 2019, EIA not accounted for backfilling. GLA demands halt to further works, repair of environmental damage.

Range CBI financial infrastructure: Dominica CBI escrow held at National Commercial Bank of Dominica. Dominica does NOT require escrow accounts to be held in-country. Zampolli alleged USD 30M distributed from Bank of Dominica account in Geneva to Asaria/Shehada. Range disputed this, stating no Bank of Dominica exists in Geneva. CBI investment thresholds: St Kitts USD 400-430K, Dominica USD 220K, Grenada USD 270K. Buyback guarantee at original price after 5 years. Annual returns up to 5% tied to hotel operations. 14 nights annually at any Range property.

findings.summary: Range UAE expansion 2020+: Range RAK developing 2500+ units across 6+ projects on Al Marjan Island Ras Al Khaimah. Projects: Beach House (88 apts), Beach Residences (420 apts + 11 townhouses), Beach Vista (151 apts), Island Heights (165 apts), Costa Mare (1023 residences across 3 buildings). Range Luxury: Dubai villas (Silk Leaf Villas, R9 Mansion Al Barari, Villa R8). Total UAE pipeline dwarfs Caribbean portfolio. UAE operation is conventional real estate, not CBI-funded -- uses Golden Visa eligibility (AED 2M+ investment) as marketing tool.

Range Kempinski-to-IHG rebrand: Cabrits Resort Dominica switched from Kempinski Hotels management to IHG InterContinental brand end of March 2023. Range also chose IHG for Grenada projects (InterContinental Grenada La Sagesse). Kempinski departure reason unstated but coincides with OCCRP investigation period (published Oct 2023). Xavier Destribats (Kempinski COO Americas) was named co-defendant in Zampolli 2019 lawsuit alongside NH.TT Construction (NH International Caribbean Ltd, Trinidad-based, largest Caribbean contractor).
UK predecessor entity Range Hospitality Ltd identified (Companies House #07114414)
findings.detail: Range Hospitality Ltd was the UK predecessor entity of Range Developments Group. Incorporated 31 Dec 2009, dissolved 28 Apr 2015. SIC code 82990 (business support). Registered: 2nd Floor, 145-157 St John Street, London EC1V 4PY. Six directors: Mohammed Hassan Asaria (DOB Nov 1978, British, UAE resident), Munaf Ali (DOB Sep 1974, British, UAE resident), Alykhan Karmali (DOB Sep 1968, Canadian, Uganda resident, MD of Mukwano Industries), Ali Hussein Alnemer (DOB Dec 1960, Saudi Arabian), plus one-day director Shiraz Walji. Key observation: Asaria, Ali, and Karmali all resigned 31 Dec 2013, leaving Saudi national Alnemer as sole remaining director. Company dissolved Apr 2015, suggesting operations had moved offshore by then.

findings.summary: Corporate family tree mapped: 9+ entities across 5+ jurisdictions with compartmentalized structure
findings.detail: Full corporate structure mapped from T&Cs, court filings, and registries. Parent: Range Developments Group (Dubai HQ, Boulevard Plaza Tower 2 Office 1104; also 76 Davies St London W1K 5RF per ZoomInfo). Subsidiaries: (1) Range Developments (#3427, 654 Madison Ave 9th FL NY), (2) Range Capital Partners (Dominica) Limited (#3432, 33 Kennedy Ave Roseau), (3) Range Capital Markets (Dominica) Limited (#3460), (4) Range International Consultants (#3464, marketing/sales arm), (5) Range Developments (Grenada) Limited (#3540, Six Senses), (6) Range Developments 2 (Grenada) Limited (#3541, InterContinental), (7) Range Developments Limited (#3543, Park Hyatt St Kitts), (8) Range RAK (#3544, UAE property). Predecessor: Range Hospitality Ltd (#3539, UK dissolved). Affiliate: Range Capital Partners LLC (#3542, NY DOS 4563258, Simon Gluck). Terms governed by England & Wales law across all CBI programs.

findings.summary: Parent entity jurisdiction still unidentified — not UK, not DIFC, likely offshore (BVI/Cayman) or UAE mainland
findings.detail: Despite extensive searching, the incorporation jurisdiction of Range Developments Group (the parent entity) remains unknown. NOT found in: UK Companies House (the Bristol Range Developments Ltd #10287038 is unrelated), DIFC public register (inaccessible/no results), ADGM public register, NY DOS. The entity operates from Dubai (Boulevard Plaza) and London (76 Davies St W1K 5RF). T&Cs specify England & Wales governing law but this does not imply UK incorporation. The predecessor entity Range Hospitality Ltd was UK-incorporated but dissolved in 2015. The group likely re-incorporated offshore (BVI is most probable for a Dubai-based international holding company) or as a UAE mainland company. BVI registry requires paid search requests and is not publicly searchable online.

findings.summary: Range rebutted M Geneva allegation: 'there is no Bank of Dominica in Geneva'
findings.detail: In response to Zampolli's allegations that M was distributed from a Bank of Dominica account in Geneva to Asaria and Shehada, Range Developments stated that 'there is no Bank of Dominica in Geneva, demonstrating how spurious the claims are.' The Zampolli lawsuit filed July 17 2019 in NY Supreme Court alleges: 800 family passports sold at ,000 each = M gross project income, M distributed to Asaria/Shehada. Zampolli claims 5% of development profits (>M). Judge Rakower Oct 2019: ordered Range Capital Partners (Dominica) Ltd to respond to subpoena duces tecum within 30 days. All other relief denied.

findings.summary: Range Developments Group is the largest non-subject hub (degree 18, betweenness 0.268, rank #3). It anchors the Caribbean CBI corporate network with 14 non-subject edges. Extremely low clustering (0.039) indicates it is the sole organizational nexus for a sprawling subsidiary network.
findings.detail: Range Developments Group connects 18 entities including: 6+ Range-branded subsidiaries (Range Capital Partners, Range Capital Markets, Range Hospitality, Range RAK, Range Luxury, Range International Consultants), key individuals (Mohammed Asaria, Kamal Shehada, Munaf Ali, Simon Gluck, Alykhan Karmali, Ali Hussein Alnemer), and sister entities (Range Developments, Range Developments Grenada/Limited). The near-zero clustering (0.039) shows these subsidiaries and personnel are isolated from each other, flowing through the parent. This is a classic holding company control structure.
